name: Mori Sonou
source:
Occupation: The "Agency", Esper

Mori made her debut in Remote Island Syndrome Part 1 as the maid of a distant relative of [url=/c71238]Koizumi Itsuki[/url], Tamaru Keiichi. However, when Tamaru Yukata seemingly murdered Keiichi, She became a key player in the scheme. However, it was revealed that the "murder" was a setup by [url=/c71238]Koizumi Itsuki[/url] and his Agency to entertain [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url].
